tools.name: organizations_search
tools.description: Search organizations, or look them up by domain. Charges 0.5 credits per returned organization. limit 0 returns only totalCount, free. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

tools.name: organizations_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a company from its domain. Returns the company's firmographics, socials and website data. Charges 0.5 credits only when the company is found. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

tools.name: organizations_find_decision_maker
tools.description: Find the decision maker of an organization with a verified email. Charges 2 credits only when a decision maker is found. Can take a few minutes. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

tools.name: persons_search
tools.description: Search persons with their emails and phones. Returns only people with an email or phone, with full contact data, and charges 1 credit per returned person. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: businesses_search, persons_search · Private data: businesses_search, persons_search, persons_lookup, contacts_create, contacts_list · Public sink: businesses_search, organizations_search, organizations_enrich, organizations_find_decision_maker, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_email, persons_find_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: businesses_search, persons_search · Private data: businesses_search, persons_search, persons_lookup, contacts_create, contacts_list · Public sink: businesses_search, organizations_search, organizations_enrich, organizations_find_decision_maker, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_email, persons_find_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
